data.content:
I sent one dispute, for UE-tf06f ($31.20). The owner chose to skip the other three drafts.

**Sent**
- **UE-tf06f, $31.20, 90% win probability, strong.** The customer reported missing Butter Chicken. The order ticket lists only Paneer Tikka Masala and Garlic Naan. The order was ready at 18:47 and picked up at 18:50.

**Drafted but skipped by the owner (not retried)**
- **UE-tf07g, $26.80, 75%, moderate.**
- **UE-tf02b, $21.50, 75%, moderate.**
- **UE-tf03c, $15.00, 87%, moderate.** The same customer account made 3 claims this period. The draft stated that as a plain count, with no conclusion drawn.

For each of these, the ticket lists the item and the pickup was prompt. Neither shows what was packed in the bag. Memory has no resolved Uber Eats history yet. The DoorDash cases with this pattern went 2 won and 1 lost. The loss was a side item that wasn't itemised on the ticket.

**Weak: needs your input**
- **UE-tf01a, $52.00, the largest deduction.** There is no order ticket on file, so the claimed Chicken Biryani (Family Size) can't be checked against the order. The win probability fell from 55% to 30%. **Please send a photo of the ticket for this order.** I'll re-run the evidence check when it arrives.

**Not pursued**
- UE-tf08h ($9.00), UE-tf09i ($14.00, 15% win probability) and UE-tf00z ($0.00, past its deadline) are recommended skips.
- UE-tf04d ($18.25, 45%) and UE-tf05e ($12.75, 55%) were outside the top 5, so I didn't investigate them.

**Next deadline:** 2026-12-12, 28 days away. Case notes are in `/plan.md`. When the platform decides UE-tf06f, tell me and I'll record the outcome.
